summary:

`Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('index.html') -Tag audit-v359-search-resume-strip -SkipScreenshots`
Final Home smoke also passed after updating `agent-last-run.json`.

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of the Search Resume strip with actual Safari/local-storage history, or rotate to Garage/Maintenance handoff visibility.
